name: Send Fax Pro: Mobile Fax App

ios.desc:
Send secure faxes from iPhone in minutes. Scan, import, sign, and send PDF documents with delivery tracking. Use built-in fax templates for IRS, CMS, SSA, USCIS, medical, legal, and business forms.

Send Fax Pro turns your iPhone or iPad into a mobile fax machine. No office equipment, no printing, and no landline required. Add a recipient number, attach your document, and send a fax directly from your phone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Send fax documents from iPhone or iPad
- Scan paper documents with your camera
- Import PDF, image, and document files
- Sign documents before sending
- Track fax delivery status
- Save fax history for later reference
- Use built-in templates for common forms
- Send documents to 100+ countries

FAX TEMPLATES INCLUDED

Use ready-made fax templates for healthcare, legal, tax, government, real estate, insurance, invoices, and business workflows. Templates help you prepare common fax documents faster when you need to send forms to offices, agencies, clinics, or business partners.

BUILT FOR IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS

Send Fax Pro is designed for personal and business faxing, including medical forms, legal paperwork, signed documents, invoices, applications, claims, records, authorizations, and time-sensitive paperwork.

CREDITS AND PRO OPTIONS

Start with flexible fax credits or upgrade to Pro when you need more faxing capacity. The app shows available options before purchase so you can choose the plan that fits your usage.

Download Send Fax Pro and send your next fax from iPhone.

LEGAL:
By using Send Fax Pro, you agree to our Terms & Privacy Policy:
https://sendfax.pro/en/terms
https://sendfax.pro/en/privacy

show_hn.title: Show HN: I completed mobile fax app in 60 hours

quotes.text:
I built a mobile fax app from scratch and submitted it to the App Store in just 60 hours. It includes:
- A React Native mobile app
- Backend
- Landing page
- App Store application

My app was approved on the first try.

Send Fax Pro: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/send-fax-pro-secure-faxing/id6748022728

Landing page: https://sendfax.pro

Also I added fax testing page at https://sendfax.pro/receive-online-free-fax

Thanks in advance for your feedback!
